cards.caption: Evening Yuvak Mandal Sabha and Kirtan Aradhana
Gives his blessings in the Yogi Jayanti Festival
Blesses the bhaktas
In a joyous mood
Councillor Michael Dolling, Mayor of Luton, garlands Bapa
Lord Dholakia, President of the Liberal Democratic Party garlands Bapa
Addresses the evening assembly
Performs dhyan in pooja
Holds up the new leaflets for BAPS Shri Swaminarayan Mandir
Folds his hands while thal is being offered
Opens a DVD titled Mare Angane Swami Padharya - Part 1
Reads letters during the sabha
Doing tilak chandlo
Offers his respect to the murtis in the upper sanctum
Performs the abhishek of Shri Nilkanth Varni
Reads the Shikshapatri and Satsang Diksha
Commences his puja by applying a tilak to his forehead
Addresses the swamis and sadhaks in the morning assembly
On his way to darshan in the morning
Performs the morning arti
Interacts with the swamis
Appreciates Bhaktiswarupdas Swami for his seva and devotion
Engrossed in meditation
Greets the swamis and sadhaks with folded hands
